description.value: The Commodore Grand Cafe & Lounge is a tapas bar and lounge on Victoria Street in downtown Kamloops, offering drinks, small plates, and occasional events. It operates exclusively as a late-night venue and maintains a VIP guest list program. The atmosphere and programming are oriented toward nightlife rather than daytime food service.

address.value: Victoria Street, City of Kamloops, V2C 3N3
